verdict.rationale: Microsoft's first-party docs show Windows as a primary developer platform. They document support for C#/.NET 8+, C++ (Win32 and C++/WinRT) and Rust, along with the Windows AI Foundry toolkit and Windows AI APIs. Community reports describe a working Ubuntu userland via WSL and compiling C code natively, and PowerShell is documented as the official CLI. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of support for the latest IDEs (e.g., Visual Studio or VS Code), little detail on mainstream AI/ML frameworks beyond Microsoft's own toolkit, and the AI APIs are scoped to Copilot+ PCs.
